diagnosis: The endpoint retrieves a Wagtail page Revision by ID and immediately publishes it without checking whether request.user has edit or publish permissions on the underlying page. Any logged-in user can revert and publish historical revisions of arbitrary pages.
exploit_request:
POST /cms-custom/revisions/482/revert/ HTTP/1.1
Host: wagtail.example.com
Cookie: sessionid=attacker_session
